arena.instruction: Predict the incoming ball from the visible launcher position and direction. After two unscored practice balls, return all 5 scored white/red balls correctly: return white balls to the far net and let red balls pass to the near net without touching the paddle. The launcher translates and aims inward only between collected balls. There are 2 scored single-wall and 0 scored two-wall incoming trajectories. The full future trajectory is not drawn. The right scoreboard counts correct scored balls after settled collection; practice balls do not increase it. After measured aiming stability, prepare for the full 4-second countdown.
